description: Chart on book p. 453 (EXT.F(II)-15). CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names CULT-INFO-FO; the chart has no label for it. The title names POL-DY (political dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: EXT-FT (extended functionalism), POL-DYM (political dynamics) and AFL (affinity alignment). From EXT-FT: PART (participation). From AFL: MPT (manipulation) and INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: SOC-RT (social reality). From INTR: MT-INFO (multi-information). From SOC-RT: POL-P (political policies). From MT-INFO: P-PROG (particular progressionalism).
